buildCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @storige/types build && pnpm --filter @storige/api openapi:partner && pnpm --filter @storige/docs build
ignoreCommand: P="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA}"; if [ -z "$P" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$P^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi; git diff --quiet "$P" HEAD ./ ../../docs ../../apps/api/src ../../packages/types ../../scripts ../../pnpm-lock.yaml

headers.value: default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
